christina-jiang-freehold-youth.alt: Four youth fencers on a podium at Freehold Fencing Academy, with Christina Jiang on the first-place box under a Freehold Fencing Academy banner and an American flag.
christina-jiang-freehold-youth.caption: Christina Jiang in first place after winning Youth 12 Women's Epee at Freehold Fencing's November Youth on Sunday, Nov. 22. The official field was four fencers.

efc-november-nac-photo.alt: Nico Ng in a white epee uniform stands on a strip in a convention-hall venue, holding a water bottle, while Remy Ng, in a blue shirt, faces him; a referee sits behind a USA Fencing banner.
efc-november-nac-photo.caption: Remy Ng coaching Nico Ng on the strip at the November NAC in Columbus. Nico finished 15th of 136 in Cadet Men's Epee (Challenger) on Nov. 21.
